title: Cardamom and Airy Omelette
description: A light and fluffy omelette infused with the warm flavors of cardamom, perfect for a quick breakfast.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with a pinch of salt.
Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add a small amount of oil to the pan and swirl it around.
Pour the egg mixture into the pan and let it cook until the edges start to set.
Sprinkle the ground cardamom over the eggs and use a spatula to gently fold the omelette in thirds.
Cook for another minute and use the spatula to carefully fold the omelette in half.
Slide the omelette out of the pan onto a plate and garnish with chopped parsley.
